title: News Briefing: iPhone 17 Zam and iPhone 18 Updates
description: Recent reports from Turkish media discuss a potential price increase for the iPhone 17 and updates regarding the iPhone 18's release and hardware challenges.

sections.heading: iPhone 17 Price Speculation
paragraphs: Webtekno has published a report questioning whether a price hike will be applied to the iPhone 17 today. The source refers to this speculation as a 'scary claim' in its coverage.

sections.heading: iPhone 18 Release and Features
paragraphs: Hürriyet has released information regarding the Apple iPhone 18. The article asks if the release date has been determined and discusses the expected features of the device. It also notes that images have been leaked.

sections.heading: Hardware and Supply Chain News
paragraphs: DonanımHaber reports that the iPhone 18 has been impacted by a DRAM crisis. According to the source, there are chips worth $1 billion that are currently waiting.

faq.q: What is the claim regarding the iPhone 17?
faq.a: According to Webtekno, there is a claim suggesting a price hike might occur for the iPhone 17 today.

faq.q: What issues are reported for the iPhone 18?
faq.a: DonanımHaber reports a DRAM crisis affecting the iPhone 18, involving $1 billion in chips waiting, while Hürriyet discusses its release date and leaked images.
